source_name: GSE178318 arm-level CNV-lite score, treated-cohort tumor-site-immune reference (this repo's own infercnv_lite_gse178318.py)
claim: Attempted chromosome-arm-level CNV score (25,376/33,694 genes resolved to an arm via local HGNC gene-position data; 43 arms with >=10 genes) to distinguish malignancy-consistent from non-confirmed cells among GSE178318's epithelial-proxy population, restricted to the 3 treated patients (COL15/COL17/COL18; 1,786 QC-passing EPCAM+ cells in PRIMARY_CRC/LIVER_METASTASIS samples), scored against a held-out half (n=19,002) of a 38,003-cell reference of QC-passing tumor-site immune cells from the same 3 treated patients (99th percentile of that held-out half sets the threshold = 12.54). Result: epithelial-proxy cells show a modest median CNV-score shift versus the held-out reference (1.32 vs 0.63, ~2.1x), directionally consistent with malignant signal, but the distributions overlap substantially -- 36/1,786 (2.02%) of epithelial-proxy cells clear the threshold vs. 190/19,002 (1.00%) of the held-out reference's own cells (enrichment ratio 2.02x, a modest enrichment, not a sharp separation). Per-sample CNV_HIGH counts are mostly single-digit (0-22 of 25-841 epithelial-proxy cells per sample), too small for a reliable per-sample prevalence estimate. Best described as an observed CNV-like score shift with an ambiguous, nonconfirmatory signal, not attributable with this method to CNV vs. lineage-driven expression differences vs. resolution loss (treated as co-equal, un-excluded explanations). Does NOT confirm malignancy at the single-cell level and does NOT produce a reliable CNV-confirmed CEACAM5 prevalence number.
provenance: This repository's own canonical DATA/registry/GSE178318/source_manifest.tsv (checksum-verified) for the matrix; DATA/1.Databases/HGNC_gene_id_mapping (already-fetched, local, read-only) for gene-to-chromosome-arm mapping, resolved via config/external_sources.yaml's module_b_gene_position_reference block (actually parsed, not hardcoded) and checksum-locked via DATA/reference/hgnc_gene_id_mapping_source_lock.tsv.
dataset_version: GSE178318 processed matrix (2026-08-11) + HGNC gene ID mapping (see link.md on the machine that has it)
metadata: This is a coarser, arm-level, independently-designed approximation of GSE178318's own publication's fine-grained InferCNV -- not a reproduction. Method and every limitation locked in analysis_contracts/infercnv_lite_gse178318.md before running. Round 2 (PR #75 round-1 review): config/external_sources.yaml is now actually parsed (was hardcoded), HGNC reference file is now checksum-locked, all reference numbers now consistently use the held-out half (not the fit half), exact CNV_HIGH exceedance fractions reported for both populations, output renamed away from "confirmed", and the InferCNV-mechanics explanation corrected.
